description: METROPOLIS – State Representative Patrick Windhorst (R-Metropolis) formally announced today that he’s running for re-election. The Metropolis Republican has built a strong conservative voting record since taking office in 2019, amassing a 100% pro-life and 100% pro-2nd Amendment record.“The people of Southern Illinois have entrusted me to represent their values in Springfield, and I am grateful for the opportunity to serve,” Windhorst said. “I have fought back against the supermajority Democrats

title: HOUSE GOP FLOOR LEADER STATE REP. PATRICK WINDHORST WILL SEEK RE-ELECTION
